data.name: The Evil Rise
data.detailed_description:
Your sister called. She said your father is not right, and there is no one else, and please come home. You swore you never would.

The house is lit when you arrive. The lamps are on. A candle is burning in the hall. There are dishes on the kitchen table that someone used recently.

Nobody has lived here for years. 

EXPLORE A HOUSE THAT IS STILL KEPT

Someone tends this place. A photograph on the kitchen counter has had a face worn smooth by a thumb. A music box in a child's bedroom has been wound in the last day. A glass of water in your sister's room is full. Every room tells you more about the family that lived here, and none of it is good.


RATION WHAT LITTLE YOU FIND

Ammunition is scarce and it stays scarce. Bitter green herbs pulled from the walls close the smaller wounds. Real medical supplies are rare enough that you will hesitate before spending one.

No encounter in this house requires a kill. A player with an empty gun can survive on movement alone, if they are good enough.

RUN, BECAUSE HE WALKS

The thing hunting you does not sprint. It walks, with one hand dragging along the wall, and the lights fail around it as it comes. Doors do not stop it. It opens them slowly, which is worse. Gunfire does not hurt it. Gunfire only tells it where you are.

For most of this game you will think it is slow.

UNLOCK THE HOUSE ONE ORGAN AT A TIME

An eye. A lung. A brain. Cast-iron keys open a house that was built like a body. Solve your way deeper through rooms that seal behind you, and work out for yourself what the last lock is going to be.

FACE WHAT IS LEFT OF THEM

Six kinds of the reclaimed dead walk this house, and every one of them used to be a person. The freshest still wear the faces they died with. That is the worst part.

A FAMILY HORROR, NOT A MONSTER MOVIE

Built alone over three years in Unreal Engine 5. Three to four hours. One ending, and there is no good version of it. The house asks a single question from the first framed photograph to the last locked door: what do you owe the people you love when they refuse to die?

Your father has already answered it.

data.short_description: A first-person survival horror game set in a house that should be empty. Ration scarce ammunition, unlock the house one organ at a time, and survive the thing that keeps the lamps lit. Your father still lives here.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti / AMD RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains graphic violence, blood, and body horror. It depicts human remains, surgical and medical imagery, and creatures that were once people. Its subject matter includes grief, terminal illness, and suicide.
